string.text: Drag a glowstick onto a free artefact belt slot to wear it as a light without using your detector hand. Light uses the glowstick's light_section as-is. Held and thrown glowsticks stay on the stock path.
Double-clicking a glowstick in inventory puts it on the artefact belt when there is room and none is already worn. Otherwise it equips to hands as usual.
